quotations.old_english: Síe he wyrðe folcryhtre [-rihtre MS. G.] bóte
quotations.english: let him be worthy of lawful compensation

source_text: folc-riht, -ryht; adj. According to folk-right, lawful; secundum publ&i-short;cum jus, l&e-long;g&a-long;lis :-- Síe he wyrðe folcryhtre [-rihtre MS. G.] bóte let him be worthy of lawful compensation, L. Alf. 13; Th. i. 46, 25.
